name: a-regex-reads-back-from-its-print
query: [#"(\d+)\.(\d+)" #"\"x\""s #"\\"] | map ~(:p it | print | parse | open | eq p)

name: a-failure-to-parse-names-a-character-and-a-flag-of-a-regex-among-its-continuations
expect: [["\\\"" "\\" :"character of a regex" "\""] [:"flag of a regex" :whitespace :end-of-source]]

name: a-flag-written-inside-is-refused-with-its-place
query: "#\"(?i)a\"" | parse !| get /message | contains "the flags follow the closing quote"

name: a-backslash-before-a-plain-character-is-refused-with-the-reason
query: "#\"a\\-b\"" | parse !| get /message | contains "a backslash stands before"

name: a-group-of-flags-is-refused-where-an-engine-reads-it
query: "#\"(?i:a)b\"" | parse !| get /message | contains "the flags follow the closing quote"

name: a-needless-backslash-is-told-by-the-source
query: "#\"a\\:b\"" | parse !| get /message | contains "a backslash stands before"

name: an-escaped-bracket-opens-no-class-before-a-group-of-flags
query: "#\"\\[(?i:a)\"" | parse !| get /message | contains "a group of flags"

name: a-group-of-flags-turned-off-is-refused-too
query: "#\"(?-i:a)\"" | parse !| get /message | contains "a group of flags"

name: a-group-of-flags-after-a-class-is-refused
query: "#\"[a](?i:b)\"" | parse !| get /message | contains "a group of flags"
